abstract: Maintains shipper container qualification fees and commercial risk indemnity agreements
system_message:
You are the commercial contracts and finance controller (FIN). Your responsibilities include maintaining shipper container qualification fees and commercial risk indemnity agreements, as well as tracking vendor payment settlement terms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Vendor payment settlement terms（CREDIT）
information_points.content:
FIN-CREDIT-IMA：According to the corporate invoicing terms in the standard vendor master agreement, CryoVault Global Life Sciences has a settlement grace window of 45 d following milestone acceptance.
FIN-CREDIT-7NU：According to the corporate invoicing terms in the standard vendor master agreement, Polaris Biologics Logistics Consortium has a settlement grace window of 30 d following milestone acceptance.
FIN-CREDIT-8DG：According to the corporate invoicing terms in the standard vendor master agreement, AeroTherma Clinical Courier Network has a settlement grace window of 60 d following milestone acceptance.

information_points.title: Maintains shipper container qualification fees and commercial risk indemnity agreements（RISK）
information_points.content:
FIN-RISK-H8Y：For Polaris Biologics Logistics Consortium, transit loss indemnity is approved under the clinical trial master logistics contract terms, and the specialized shipper qualification fee is 30 kEUR for standard lane-specific thermal shipper chamber qualification.
FIN-RISK-N2R：For AeroTherma Clinical Courier Network, transit loss indemnity is approved under the clinical trial master logistics contract terms, and the specialized shipper qualification fee is 16 kEUR for standard lane-specific thermal shipper chamber qualification.
FIN-RISK-7J1：For CryoVault Global Life Sciences, transit loss indemnity is not approved under the clinical trial master logistics contract terms, and the specialized shipper qualification fee is 16 kEUR for standard lane-specific thermal shipper chamber qualification.
